title: HJM application contract v1
description: Machine-readable contract for an application governed by the portfolio default profile.

contractVersion.description: Contract schema generation; 1 is HJM-APP-STANDARD v1.

profile.description: Portfolio profile that supplies the exact trains and policies; only portfolio-default-v1 exists.

app.description: Canonical identity and lifecycle. lifecycle must equal the portfolio.json catalog entry (doctor blocks a mismatch).

governance.description: Document status, owner, review date and the merge authority the app defers to. status draft pairs with lifecycle incubating; active pairs with active/maintenance/retiring.

runtimes.description: Only the runtimes that exist. Each pins the profile framework train exactly; new kinds require a standard revision.

documents.description: Canonical document paths; the Acceptance/Evidence tables inside them are projections of this contract (sync-docs).

toolchain.description: Exact Node and pnpm versions plus the canonical script graph that pnpm check runs.

designSystem.description: HJM contracts/renderer versions, catalog snapshot pin, required foundations and optional beta adoptions; not_applicable only for server-only products.

i18n.description: Locale list, source and fallback locale, and the message catalog ownership.

release.description: Release targets and whether Release Hub applies; not_applicable requires a rationale.

acceptance.description: Criteria per required category and the evidence records that back them. Evidence is a file or an index.md directory under docs/evidence/ (digest-evidence).

waivers.description: Time-boxed exceptions to default rules only; never to required rules and never a substitute for acceptance.

if.description: Claiming conformance (governance active/superseded) requires a verified external merge authority; product lifecycle alone does not.

check.const: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm build && pnpm i18n:check && pnpm design:check && pnpm contract:check && pnpm docs:check
